doc.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006

chapter: New Orleans families, lifestyle and retirement
title: Closing words of wisdom
summary: Rowe thanks Jordan for his wisdom, who invites more questions.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well man that’s some great words of wisdom. And I appreciate you sharing it with us. And I’m just kind of—
You can ask me whatever you want to ask me now, ‘cause, you’ll say oh man I should have asked him this and I didn’t. I know how it is.
Well I’m really happy that we had this conversation and you know the wisdom that you’ve acquired in your years both in education and in playing really comes through.
